metaDescription: Order custom Beacon putty in bulk. Perfect for stress relief and brand visibility. Soft CTA: Shop now at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Beacon putty is a trusted name in promotional stress relievers, known for its non-toxic, silicone-based formula that won't dry out or crumble. When you choose custom Beacon putty, you get a squeezable, moldable product that holds fine details like logos or text through pad printing. Ideal for trade shows, corporate gifts, or safety incentives, Beacon putty offers a soft, consistent texture that recipients keep using. Ordering in bulk ensures you have a reliable giveaway that stands out without sticky residue or mess.
heroAltText: Custom Beacon putty with company logo printed on the surface, ideal for promotional giveaways
